OCR = reading the text out of scanned pages (photos).
For that you need the free Tesseract program.

STEPS
1. Download the Windows installer from:
   https://github.com/UB-Mannheim/tesseract/wiki
   (the file is called something like tesseract-ocr-w64-setup-....exe)

2. Run the installer. IMPORTANT: at the language step
   ("Additional language data") tick the languages you need, so
   accented letters are read correctly.

3. Keep the default folder:
   C:\Program Files\Tesseract-OCR

4. Close and reopen PDF Tool. The OCR buttons enable themselves.

If you installed it somewhere else, add that folder to the PATH
environment variable, or reinstall to the default location.
